default.$description: Default color for non-interactive icons. Product identity is resolved by semantic mode.

inverse.$description: Inverse icon color for icons on sufficiently dark surfaces, brand surfaces, gradients, or images. Resolves to shared color/white in both product modes. Does not include opacity or component-level contrast treatments; validate contextual legibility before use.

secondary.$description: Secondary color for non-interactive icons that accompany supporting content or metadata on light surfaces. Use when color/icon/default creates excessive prominence. Resolves through Semantic modes and does not replace inverse, brand, action, feedback, disabled, or component-specific icon tokens. DTCG: color.icon.secondary ($type: color).

default.$description: Default brand-colored icon for explicit product identity in non-interactive contexts. Use when product identity is intentionally part of the message; do not use for actions, links, navigation states, feedback, logos, illustrations, or component-owned icon color. TEC 360 resolves to turquoise/on-light and must not be the sole non-text cue on white until 3:1 contrast is met. DTCG: color.icon.brand.default ($type: color).

subtle.$description: Subtle brand-colored icon for decorative, redundant, or low-emphasis product identity. Do not use as the sole carrier of meaning on light surfaces. TEC 360 current alias does not meet 3:1 on white and therefore requires accompanying text or a validated background. DTCG: color.icon.brand.subtle ($type: color).

strong.$description: Strong brand-colored icon for explicit high-emphasis product identity in non-interactive contexts. Use sparingly and only when brand emphasis is intentional; do not replace feedback, action, inverse, or component-owned icon tokens. DTCG: color.icon.brand.strong ($type: color).

default.$description: Superficie base de contenido. Usar en cards, paneles, modales y contenedores sobre canvas. No representa elevación ni estado interactivo.

canvas.$description: Fondo global de página o vista. Usar en el frame raíz. No usar en cards, módulos internos ni estados interactivos.

subtle.$description: Superficie clara para diferenciar secciones o bandas sin elevación. Puede usarse dentro de canvas para separación ligera.

raised.$description: Superficie elevada visualmente sobre canvas o default. Usar en cards elevadas, popovers, dropdowns, modales o paneles flotantes. Debe separarse mediante shadow y/o border; el color por sí solo no representa elevation. No usar como fondo global ni como estado interactivo.

sunken.$description: Superficie visualmente contenida o hundida dentro de otra surface. Usar en data wells, áreas internas, code blocks, filtros, campos agrupados o frames que contienen información. Debe percibirse más profunda que canvas/default. No usar para cards elevadas, overlays ni estados disabled.

inverse.$description: Superficie oscura funcional que requiere contenido inverse. No usar como overlay ni como sustituto de imágenes o gradientes.

overlay.$description: Scrim semitransparente detrás de modal, dialog o drawer. No usar como fondo de sección.

transparent.$description: Ausencia intencional de superficie visible. Usar cuando debe permanecer visible la superficie del contenedor padre.

ring.$description: Shared semantic focus indicator color for keyboard focus. Canonical Focus Ring contract: external ring, 2 px stroke, 4 px offset from the component boundary, radius follows the focused control, rendered on :focus-visible. Functional accessibility color shared across TEC 360 and TEC Educación Continua; component focus tokens should alias this semantic token. Inverse/dark contexts currently reuse this same semantic focus color until a dedicated accessibility recipe is approved.
